descriptionFull: The red-billed chough , Cornish chough or simply chough (/ˈtʃʌf/ CHUFF ) ( Pyrrhocorax pyrrhocorax ), is a bird in the crow family, one of only two species in the genus Pyrrhocorax . Its eight subspecies breed on mountains and coastal cliffs from the western coasts of Ireland and Britain east through southern Europe and North Africa to Central Asia, India and China.
